title: Assess distress and manage formal restructuring
summary: A specialist-reviewed distress decision and authorized restructuring or insolvency handoff with actions, receipts and outstanding duties tracked.
outcomes: A specialist-reviewed distress decision and authorized restructuring or insolvency handoff with actions, receipts and outstanding duties tracked.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When payment difficulties, creditor action or financial forecasts indicate possible insolvency or a formal restructuring need.

parts.title: Assemble an urgent financial and creditor record
parts.guidance: Prepare current cash, liabilities, overdue amounts, asset records, forecasts, security interests, guarantees and creditor notices in the private case file. Flag imminent hearings, demands or payment failures immediately to the accountable directors and adviser.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Obtain the specialist distress assessment
parts.guidance: The directors obtain qualified local insolvency and legal advice on the actual financial position, duties and available routes. This guide does not determine solvency or authorize continued trading, asset transfers, distributions or a solvent strike-off route.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.reason: The step is the named human decision or human-performed work itself; policies/AGENT_POLICY.md reserves it to a human with case-specific authorization on every run.

parts.title: Prepare the reviewed options and action timetable
parts.guidance: Under adviser instructions, prepare the options, cash and creditor schedules, required decision records and proposed communication plan. Keep operational continuity, employee issues, secured claims and disputed liabilities visible; do not infer that a proposed rescue has legal effect.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Approve the specific restructuring or insolvency route
parts.guidance: The authorized decision-makers approve the adviser-reviewed route and any required appointments, applications or communications. Keep named authority and specialist review for each consequential action; unresolved duties or deadlines require urgent escalation.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.scope: Approve the specific restructuring or insolvency route

parts.title: Hand off and carry out authorized formal actions
parts.guidance: The appointed practitioner, lawyer or authorized person completes the approved notices, applications and appointments through the applicable route. Record the responsible operator and retain formal acceptance and case references; an internal plan does not start a formal procedure.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.reason: The step is the named human decision or human-performed work itself; policies/AGENT_POLICY.md reserves it to a human with case-specific authorization on every run.

parts.title: Track formal milestones and continuing duties
parts.guidance: Reconcile the adviser handoff, formal case records and approved communications. Maintain a dated action register for required reports, payments and continuing duties, and obtain the specialist completion or closure evidence before closing the case.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.
